units.zh: 孟嘗君名文，姓田氏。
units.en: Lord Mengchang was Tian Wen of the Tian clan.
units.literal: Lord Mengchang's name was Wen, and his surname was Tian.

units.zh: 文之父曰靖郭君田嬰。
units.en: Tian Wen's father was called Lord Jingguo, Tian Ying.
units.literal: Wen's father was called Lord Jingguo, Tian Ying.

units.zh: 田嬰者，齊威王少子而齊宣王庶弟也。
units.en: Tian Ying was King Wei of Qi's youngest son and King Xuan of Qi's half-brother.
units.literal: Tian Ying was Qi Wei King's youngest son and Qi Xuan King's younger half-brother.

units.zh: 田嬰自威王時任職用事，與成侯鄒忌及田忌將而救韓伐魏。
units.en: Tian Ying held office and managed affairs from King Wei's time onward. Together with Lord Cheng Zou Ji and the general Tian Ji, he rescued Han and attacked Wei.
units.literal: Tian Ying from Wei King time hold office handle affairs, with Cheng Hou Zou Ji and Tian Ji general save Han attack Wei.

units.zh: 成侯與田忌爭寵，成侯賣田忌。
units.en: Lord Cheng contended with Tian Ji for favor, and Lord Cheng betrayed Tian Ji.
units.literal: Cheng Hou with Tian Ji contend favor, Cheng Hou sell out Tian Ji.

units.zh: 田忌懼，襲齊之邊邑，不勝，亡走。
units.en: Tian Ji was afraid, attacked Qi's border cities, did not succeed, and fled.
units.literal: Tian Ji fear, attack Qi border city, not win, flee go.

units.zh: 會威王卒，宣王立，知成侯賣田忌，乃復召田忌以為將。
units.en: When King Wei died and King Xuan ascended, King Xuan learned that Lord Cheng had betrayed Tian Ji, and summoned Tian Ji back to serve as general.
units.literal: Meet Wei King die, Xuan King stand, know Cheng Hou sell out Tian Ji, then again summon Tian Ji as general.

units.zh: 宣王二年，田忌與孫臏、田嬰俱伐魏，敗之馬陵，虜魏太子申而殺魏將龐涓。
units.en: In King Xuan's second year, Tian Ji together with Sun Bin and Tian Ying attacked Wei, defeated them at Ma Ling, captured Wei's crown prince Shen, and killed Wei's general Pang Juan.
units.literal: Xuan King two years, Tian Ji with Sun Bin, Tian Ying together attack Wei, defeat at Ma Ling, capture Wei crown prince Shen kill Wei general Pang Juan.

units.zh: 宣王七年，田嬰使於韓、魏，韓、魏服於齊。
units.en: In King Xuan's seventh year, Tian Ying was envoy to Han and Wei, and Han and Wei submitted to Qi.
units.literal: Xuan King seven years, Tian Ying envoy to Han Wei, Han Wei submit to Qi.

units.zh: 嬰與韓昭侯、魏惠王會齊宣王東阿南，盟而去。
units.en: Ying, Marquis Zhao of Han, and King Hui of Wei met King Xuan of Qi south of Dong'e, formed an alliance, and departed.
units.literal: Ying with Han Zhao Hou, Wei Hui King meet Qi Xuan King Dong E south, alliance depart.

units.zh: 明年，復與梁惠王會甄。
units.en: The next year, he again met King Hui of Liang at Zhen.
units.literal: Next year, again with Liang Hui King meet Zhen.

units.zh: 是歲，梁惠王卒。
units.en: This year, King Hui of Liang died.
units.literal: This year, Liang Hui King die.

units.zh: 宣王九年，田嬰相齊。
units.en: In King Xuan's ninth year, Tian Ying became chancellor of Qi.
units.literal: Xuan King nine years, Tian Ying chancellor Qi.

units.zh: 齊宣王與魏襄王會徐州而相王也。
units.en: King Xuan of Qi and King Xiang of Wei met at Xuzhou and mutually declared themselves kings.
units.literal: Qi Xuan King with Wei Xiang King meet Xu Zhou mutually wang.

units.zh: 楚威王聞之，怒田嬰。
units.en: When King Wei of Chu heard this, he was angry with Tian Ying.
units.literal: Chu Wei King hear, angry Tian Ying.

units.zh: 明年，楚伐敗齊師於徐州，而使人逐田嬰。
units.en: The next year, Chu attacked and defeated Qi forces at Xuzhou, and sent men to pursue Tian Ying.
units.literal: Next year, Chu attack defeat Qi forces at Xu Zhou, make person pursue Tian Ying.

units.zh: 田嬰使張丑說楚威王，威王乃止。
units.en: Tian Ying sent Zhang Chou to persuade King Wei of Chu, and King Wei then stopped.
units.literal: Tian Ying make Zhang Chou advise Chu Wei King, Wei King then stop.

units.zh: 田嬰相齊十一年，宣王卒，湣王即位。
units.en: Tian Ying served as chancellor of Qi for eleven years. King Xuan died, and King Min ascended the throne.
units.literal: Tian Ying chancellor Qi eleven years, Xuan King die, Min King ascend throne.

units.zh: 即位三年，而封田嬰於薛。
units.en: After three years on the throne, he enfeoffed Tian Ying at Xue.
units.literal: Ascend throne three years, enfeoff Tian Ying at Xue.

units.zh: 初，田嬰有子四十餘人。
units.en: Originally, Tian Ying had over forty sons.
units.literal: Originally, Tian Ying have son forty more people.

units.zh: 其賤妾有子名文，文以五月五日生。
units.en: His lowly concubine bore a son named Tian Wen, and the child was born on the fifth day of the fifth month.
units.literal: His lowly concubine have son name Wen, Wen with five month five day born.

units.zh: 嬰告其母曰：「勿舉也。」
units.en: Ying told the mother: 'Do not raise him.'
units.literal: Ying tell his mother: Do not raise.

units.zh: 其母竊舉生之。
units.en: His mother secretly raised him.
units.literal: His mother secretly raised him and kept him alive.

units.zh: 及長，其母因兄弟而見其子文於田嬰。
units.en: When he grew up, his mother used his brothers as an excuse to present her son Tian Wen to Tian Ying.
units.literal: Reach grow, his mother because brothers see their son Wen to Tian Ying.

units.zh: 田嬰怒其母曰：「吾令若去此子，而敢生之，何也？」
units.en: Tian Ying angrily berated his mother: 'I commanded you to abandon this child, yet you dared to raise him. Why?'
units.literal: Tian Ying angry at his mother: I commanded you to abandon this child, yet you dared to raise him; why?

units.zh: 文頓首，因曰：「君所以不舉五月子者，何故？」
units.en: Tian Wen kowtowed and said: 'My lord, why do you not raise children born in the fifth month?'
units.literal: Wen kowtow, because say: Jun so not raise five month child, what reason?

units.zh: 嬰曰：「五月子者，長與戶齊，將不利其父母。」
units.en: Ying said: 'Children born in the fifth month grow up to be as tall as the door, which will bring harm to their parents.'
units.literal: Ying say: Five month child, grow with door even, will harm parents.

units.zh: 文曰：「人生受命於天乎？
units.en: Tian Wen said: 'Does a person's life receive its mandate from Heaven?
units.literal: Wen say: Person life receive mandate from heaven?

units.zh: 將受命於戶邪？」
units.en: Or does it receive its mandate from the door?'
units.literal: Will receive mandate from door?"

units.zh: 嬰默然。
units.en: Ying fell silent.
units.literal: Ying silent.

units.zh: 文曰：「必受命於天，君何憂焉。
units.en: Tian Wen said: 'If one's mandate comes from Heaven, what does my lord have to worry about?
units.literal: Wen say: Must receive mandate from heaven, jun what worry.

units.zh: 必受命於戶，則可高其戶耳，誰能至者！」
units.en: If it comes from the door, then make the door higher. Who could ever reach it?'
units.literal: Must receive mandate from door, then can high its door, who can reach!"

units.zh: 嬰曰：「子休矣。」
units.en: Ying said: 'Enough, my son.'
units.literal: Ying say: Son rest.

units.zh: 久之，文承閒問其父嬰曰：「子之子為何？」
units.en: After a long time, Tian Wen took the opportunity to ask his father Ying: 'What is a son's son called?'
units.literal: Long time, Wen take opportunity ask his father Ying: Son son what?

units.zh: 曰：「為孫。」
units.en: He said: 'A grandson.'
units.literal: Say: For grandson.

units.zh: 「孫之孫為何？」
units.en: 'What is a grandson's grandson called?'
units.literal: Grandson grandson what?

units.zh: 曰：「為玄孫。」
units.en: He said: 'A great-grandson.'
units.literal: Say: For great grandson.

units.zh: 「玄孫之孫為何？」
units.en: 'What is a great-grandson's grandson called?'
units.literal: Great grandson grandson what?

units.zh: 曰：「不能知也。」
units.en: He said: 'I cannot know.'
units.literal: Say: Cannot know.

units.zh: 文曰：「君用事相齊，至今三王矣，齊不加廣而君私家富累萬金，門下不見一賢者。
units.en: Tian Wen said: 'My lord has handled Qi's affairs as chancellor through three reigns, yet Qi's territory has not expanded while your private household has accumulated wealth by the tens of thousands in gold, and not one worthy man is seen among your retainers.
units.literal: Wen say: Jun handle affairs chancellor Qi, to now three kings, Qi not add broad yet jun private family rich accumulate ten thousand gold, gate below not see one worthy.

units.zh: 文聞將門必有將，相門必有相。
units.en: I have heard that a general's house must produce generals, and a chancellor's house must produce chancellors.
units.literal: Wen hear will gate must have general, chancellor gate must have chancellor.

units.zh: 今君後宮蹈綺縠而士不得（短）［裋］褐，仆妾餘粱肉而士不厭糟糠。
units.en: Now the women of your inner palace tread on silk and gauze, while scholars cannot obtain coarse cloth; servants and concubines have fine grain and meat left over, while scholars cannot fill themselves on bran and chaff.
units.literal: Now ruler rear palace step silk satin yet scholar not obtain coarse cloth, servant concubine remain fine grain meat yet scholar not satiated bran chaff.

units.zh: 今君又尚厚積餘藏，欲以遺所不知何人，而忘公家之事日損，文竊怪之。」
units.en: Now you still pile up surplus stores, intending to leave them to people whose identity you cannot even know, while the affairs of the public house decline day by day. I privately find this strange.'
units.literal: Now ruler moreover still thick accumulate surplus store, wish leave to not know what person, forget public family affairs day damage, Wen secretly strange it."

units.zh: 於是嬰乃禮文，使主家待賓客。
units.en: Ying then treated Tian Wen with courtesy and had him manage the household to receive guests.
units.literal: Ying then treated Wen with courtesy and made him manage the household to receive guests.

units.zh: 賓客日進，名聲聞於諸侯。
units.en: Guests came daily, and his reputation was heard among the feudal lords.
units.literal: Guests day advance, name sound heard at feudal lords.

units.zh: 諸侯皆使人請薛公田嬰以文為太子，嬰許之。
units.en: All the feudal lords sent envoys asking Lord Xue, Tian Ying, to make Tian Wen his heir, and Ying agreed.
units.literal: Feudal lords all make person request Xue Gong Tian Ying with Wen as crown prince, Ying permit.

units.zh: 嬰卒，謚為靖郭君。
units.en: Ying died and was posthumously named Lord Jingguo.
units.literal: Ying die, posthumous name Jing Guo Jun.

units.zh: 而文果代立於薛，是為孟嘗君。
units.en: And Tian Wen indeed succeeded to the position at Xue, becoming Lord Mengchang.
units.literal: Wen indeed succeed stand at Xue, is Meng Chang Jun.

units.zh: 孟嘗君在薛，招致諸侯賓客及亡人有罪者，皆歸孟嘗君。
units.en: At Xue, Lord Mengchang recruited guests from among the feudal lords, as well as fugitives and men guilty of crimes, and they all attached themselves to him.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun at Xue, recruit attract feudal lords guests and flee have crime people, all belong Meng Chang Jun.

units.zh: 孟嘗君舍業厚遇之，以故傾天下之士。
units.en: Lord Mengchang housed them and treated them generously, and for this reason drew to himself the scholars of the world.
units.literal: Mengchang Jun set aside his estate and treated them generously; for this reason he drew the scholars of the world.

units.zh: 食客數千人，無貴賤一與文等。
units.en: His retainers numbered several thousand, and he treated them all equally regardless of noble or lowly status.
units.literal: Eat guests several thousand people, no noble lowly one with Wen equal.

units.zh: 孟嘗君待客坐語，而屏風後常有侍史，主記君所與客語，問親戚居處。
units.en: When Lord Mengchang received guests and sat speaking with them, behind the screen there was always an attendant scribe who recorded what the lord said to the guest and inquired about the guest's relatives and dwelling places.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun receive guests sit speak, screen behind often have serve historian, main record ruler with guest speak, ask relatives dwell place.

units.zh: 客去，孟嘗君已使使存問，獻遺其親戚。
units.en: When a guest departed, Lord Mengchang had already sent messengers to visit and inquire after the guest's relatives and to present them with gifts.
units.literal: Guest go, Meng Chang Jun already make messenger visit ask, offer send their relatives.

units.zh: 孟嘗君曾待客夜食，有一人蔽火光。
units.en: Lord Mengchang once received guests for a night meal, and there was one person who blocked the firelight.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun once receive guest night eat, have one person block fire light.

units.zh: 客怒，以飯不等，輟食辭去。
units.en: The guest grew angry because the rice portions were unequal, stopped eating, and left.
units.literal: Guest angry, with rice not equal, stop eat leave go.

units.zh: 孟嘗君起，自持其飯比之。
units.en: Lord Mengchang rose and personally held his rice portion to compare it.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun rise, self hold his rice compare.

units.zh: 客慚，自剄。
units.en: The guest was ashamed and committed suicide.
units.literal: Guest ashamed, self stab.

units.zh: 士以此多歸孟嘗君。
units.en: Many scholars came to belong to Lord Mengchang for this reason.
units.literal: Scholars with this many belong Meng Chang Jun.

units.zh: 孟嘗君客無所擇，皆善遇之。
units.en: Lord Mengchang made no distinctions among his guests, treating them all well.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun guest no choose, all good treat them.

units.zh: 人人各自以為孟嘗君親己。
units.en: Each person considered himself personally close to Lord Mengchang.
units.literal: People people self consider Meng Chang Jun close self.

units.zh: 秦昭王聞其賢，乃先使涇陽君為質於齊，以求見孟嘗君。
units.en: King Zhao of Qin heard of his worthiness, and first sent Lord Jingyang as hostage to Qi to seek an audience with Lord Mengchang.
units.literal: Qin Zhao King hear his worthy, then first make Jing Yang Jun as hostage at Qi, to seek see Meng Chang Jun.

units.zh: 孟嘗君將入秦，賓客莫欲其行，諫，不聽。
units.en: Lord Mengchang was about to enter Qin. His guests advised against the trip, but he would not listen.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun will enter Qin, guests not wish his go, advise, not listen.

units.zh: 蘇代謂曰：「今旦代從外來，見木禺人與土禺人相與語。
units.en: Su Dai said: 'This morning I came in from outside and saw a wooden puppet and an earthen puppet speaking with each other.
units.literal: Su Dai say: Now morning Dai from outside come, see wood puppet person with earth puppet person mutually speak.

units.zh: 木禺人曰：『天雨，子將敗矣。』
units.en: The wooden puppet said, "If heaven rains, you will be ruined."
units.literal: Wood puppet person say: Heaven rain, you will ruin.

units.zh: 土禺人曰：『我生於土，敗則歸土。
units.en: The earthen puppet said, "I was born from earth, and if ruined, I return to earth.
units.literal: Earth puppet person say: I born from earth, ruin then return earth.

units.zh: 今天雨，流子而行，未知所止息也。』
units.en: Now if heaven rains, it will wash you away, and I do not know where you will find rest."
units.literal: Now heaven rain, flow you go, unknown where stop rest.

units.zh: 今秦，虎狼之國也，而君欲往，如有不得還，君得無為土禺人所笑乎？」
units.en: Now Qin is a tiger-and-wolf state, and my lord wishes to go there. If you cannot return, will you not be laughed at by the earthen puppet?'
units.literal: Now Qin, tiger wolf country, jun wish go, if have not obtain return, jun obtain no for earth puppet person laughed?"

units.zh: 孟嘗君乃止。
units.en: Lord Mengchang then stopped.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun then stop.

units.zh: 齊湣王二十五年，復卒使孟嘗君入秦，昭王即以孟嘗君為秦相。
units.en: In the twenty-fifth year of King Min of Qi, they finally sent Lord Mengchang into Qin again, and King Zhao immediately made Lord Mengchang chancellor of Qin.
units.literal: Qi Min King twenty five years, again finally make Meng Chang Jun enter Qin, Zhao King then with Meng Chang Jun as Qin chancellor.

units.zh: 人或說秦昭王曰：「孟嘗君賢，而又齊族也，今相秦，必先齊而後秦，秦其危矣。」
units.en: Someone advised King Zhao of Qin: 'Lord Mengchang is worthy, but he is also a member of the Qi ruling house. If he now serves as Qin's chancellor, he will surely put Qi first and Qin second. Qin will be in danger.'
units.literal: Person or advise Qin Zhao Wang: Meng Chang Jun worthy, moreover Qi clan, now chancellor Qin, certainly first Qi after Qin, Qin its danger.

units.zh: 於是秦昭王乃止。
units.en: King Zhao of Qin then stopped.
units.literal: King Zhao of Qin then stopped.

units.zh: 囚孟嘗君，謀欲殺之。
units.en: They imprisoned Lord Mengchang and plotted to kill him.
units.literal: Imprison Meng Chang Jun, plan wish kill him.

units.zh: 孟嘗君使人抵昭王幸姬求解。
units.en: Lord Mengchang sent someone to bribe King Zhao's favored concubine to seek his release.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun make person bribe Zhao King favored concubine seek release.

units.zh: 幸姬曰：「妾願得君狐白裘。」
units.en: The favored concubine said: 'I wish to have your white fox-fur coat.'
units.literal: Favored concubine say: Concubine wish obtain jun fox white fur coat.

units.zh: 此時孟嘗君有一狐白裘，直千金，天下無雙，入秦獻之昭王，更無他裘。
units.en: At this time Lord Mengchang had a white fox fur coat worth a thousand in gold, unmatched in the world, which he had presented to King Zhao upon entering Qin, and he had no other furs.
units.literal: This time Meng Chang Jun have one fox white fur coat, worth thousand gold, world no double, enter Qin offer Zhao King, more no other fur coat.

units.zh: 孟嘗君患之，遍問客，莫能對。
units.en: Lord Mengchang was troubled by this and asked all his guests extensively, but none could answer.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun troubled, extensively ask guests, none can answer.

units.zh: 最下坐有能為狗盜者，曰：「臣能得狐白裘。」
units.en: Among those seated lowest was one who could act as a dog thief, who said: 'I can obtain the white fox fur coat.'
units.literal: Most low sit have can be dog thief, say: Minister can obtain fox white fur coat.

units.zh: 乃夜為狗，以入秦宮臧中，取所獻狐白裘至，以獻秦王幸姬。
units.en: That night he crawled like a dog into the Qin palace storehouse, took the white fox-fur coat that had been presented there, and offered it to the King of Qin's favored concubine.
units.literal: Then night be dog, enter Qin palace storehouse, take offered fox white fur coat come, offer Qin King favored concubine.

units.zh: 幸姬為言昭王，昭王釋孟嘗君。
units.en: The favored concubine spoke on his behalf to King Zhao, and King Zhao released Lord Mengchang.
units.literal: Favored concubine for speak Zhao King, Zhao King release Meng Chang Jun.

units.zh: 孟嘗君得出，即馳去，更封傳，變名姓以出關。
units.en: Once Lord Mengchang was released, he immediately galloped away, changed the seals on his travel documents, and passed through the frontier under a changed name and surname.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun obtain emerge, then gallop go, change seal pass, change name surname emerge pass.

units.zh: 夜半至函谷關。
units.en: At midnight, he arrived at Hangu Pass.
units.literal: Night half arrive Han Gu Pass.

units.zh: 秦昭王後悔出孟嘗君，求之已去，即使人馳傳逐之。
units.en: King Zhao of Qin afterward regretted releasing Lord Mengchang. He sought him, but he had already gone, so he sent men galloping with passports to pursue him.
units.literal: Qin Zhao King after regret release Meng Chang Jun, seek already go, then make person gallop pass pursue.

units.zh: 孟嘗君至關，關法雞鳴而出客，孟嘗君恐追至，客之居下坐者有能為雞鳴，而雞齊鳴，遂發傳出。
units.en: Lord Mengchang arrived at the pass, where the law allowed travelers out only at cockcrow. He feared the pursuers would arrive, so one of his lowest-seated guests imitated a rooster's cry. The roosters all crowed together, and the pass officials issued his documents and let him out.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun arrive pass, pass law chicken crow emerge guest, Meng Chang Jun fear pursue arrive, guest dwell low sit have can be chicken crow, chicken together crow, then issue pass emerge.

units.zh: 出如食頃，秦追果至關，已後孟嘗君出，乃還。
units.en: They emerged about the time it takes to eat a meal. The Qin pursuers indeed arrived at the pass, but already after Lord Mengchang had emerged, so they returned.
units.literal: Emerge like eat time, Qin pursue indeed arrive pass, already after Meng Chang Jun emerge, then return.

units.zh: 始孟嘗君列此二人於賓客，賓客盡羞之，及孟嘗君有秦難，卒此二人拔之。
units.en: Originally Lord Mengchang ranked these two among his guests, and all the guests were ashamed of them. When Lord Mengchang had difficulty in Qin, these two finally pulled him out.
units.literal: Begin Meng Chang Jun list this two people at guests, guests all ashamed, reach Meng Chang Jun have Qin difficulty, finally this two people pull him.

units.zh: 自是之後，客皆服。
units.en: From this time on, all the guests submitted.
units.literal: From this after, guests all submit.

units.zh: 孟嘗君過趙，趙平原君客之。
units.en: Lord Mengchang passed through Zhao, and Lord Pingyuan of Zhao hosted him as a guest.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun pass Zhao, Zhao Ping Yuan Jun guest him.

units.zh: 趙人聞孟嘗君賢，出觀之，皆笑曰：「始以薛公為魁然也，今視之，乃眇小丈夫耳。」
units.en: The people of Zhao heard Lord Mengchang was worthy and came out to view him. They all laughed, saying: 'Originally we took Lord Xue to be outstanding, but now seeing him, he is just a small, short fellow.'
units.literal: Zhao people hear Meng Chang Jun worthy, emerge view him, all laugh: Begin with Xue Gong as outstanding, now see him, is small short man.

units.zh: 孟嘗君聞之，怒。
units.en: Lord Mengchang heard this and grew angry.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun hear, angry.

units.zh: 客與俱者下，斫擊殺數百人，遂滅一縣以去。
units.en: The guests traveling with him dismounted and struck them down, killing several hundred people; then they wiped out a county and departed.
units.literal: Guests with together below, chop attack kill several hundred people, then extinguish one county go.

units.zh: 齊湣王不自得，以其遣孟嘗君。
units.en: King Min of Qi felt uneasy because he had sent Lord Mengchang away.
units.literal: Qi Min King not self obtain, with his send Meng Chang Jun.

units.zh: 孟嘗君至，則以為齊相，任政。
units.en: When Lord Mengchang arrived, King Min made him chancellor of Qi and entrusted government to him.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun arrive, then with as Qi chancellor, hold government.

units.zh: 孟嘗君怨秦，將以齊為韓、魏攻楚，因與韓、魏攻秦，而借兵食於西周。
units.en: Lord Mengchang resented Qin and planned to use Qi to attack Chu for Han and Wei, then joined with Han and Wei to attack Qin, borrowing troops and provisions from Western Zhou.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun resent Qin, will with Qi for Han Wei attack Chu, because with Han Wei attack Qin, borrow soldiers food at west Zhou.

units.zh: 蘇代為西周謂曰：「君以齊為韓、魏攻楚九年，取宛、葉以北以彊韓、魏，今復攻秦以益之。
units.en: Su Dai, on behalf of Western Zhou, advised him: 'My lord used Qi to attack Chu for Han and Wei for nine years, taking Wan and north of Ye to strengthen Han and Wei. Now you attack Qin again to benefit them further.
units.literal: Su Dai for west Zhou advise: Jun with Qi for Han Wei attack Chu nine years, take Wan Ye north strengthen Han Wei, now again attack Qin increase them.

units.zh: 韓、魏南無楚憂，西無秦患，則齊危矣。
units.en: If Han and Wei no longer have Chu to worry about in the south or Qin to fear in the west, then Qi will be in danger.
units.literal: Han Wei south no Chu worry, west no Qin suffer, then Qi danger.

units.zh: 韓、魏必輕齊畏秦，臣為君危之。
units.en: Han and Wei will surely slight Qi and fear Qin. I consider this dangerous for my lord.
units.literal: Han Wei certainly light Qi fear Qin, minister for ruler danger it.

units.zh: 君不如令敝邑深合於秦，而君無攻，又無借兵食。
units.en: My lord would do better to have my humble state join closely with Qin, while you refrain from attacking and from borrowing troops and provisions.
units.literal: Jun not as make poor city deep unite Qin, ruler no attack, moreover no borrow soldiers food.

units.zh: 君臨函谷而無攻，令敝邑以君之情謂秦昭王曰『薛公必不破秦以彊韓、魏。
units.en: You can approach Hangu Pass without attacking, and have my humble state convey your intentions to King Zhao of Qin: "Lord Xue will certainly not break Qin in order to strengthen Han and Wei.
units.literal: Jun face Han Gu no attack, make poor city with ruler emotion tell Qin Zhao King say Xue Gong certainly not break Qin strengthen Han Wei.

units.zh: 其攻秦也，欲王之令楚王割東國以與齊，而秦出楚懷王以為和』。
units.en: His attack on Qin is meant to have Your Majesty order the King of Chu to cede the eastern territories to Qi, while Qin releases King Huai of Chu as part of the settlement."
units.literal: His attack Qin, wish wang make Chu King divide east country give Qi, Qin emerge Chu Huai King for peace.

units.zh: 君令敝邑以此惠秦，秦得無破而以東國自免也，秦必欲之。
units.en: If my lord has my humble state use this to benefit Qin, Qin can escape defeat by using the eastern territories to free itself. Qin will certainly want this.
units.literal: Jun make poor city with this favor Qin, Qin obtain no break give east country self avoid, Qin certainly wish.

units.zh: 楚王得出，必德齊。
units.en: Once the King of Chu is released, he will certainly be grateful to Qi.
units.literal: Chu King obtain emerge, certainly virtue Qi.

units.zh: 齊得東國益彊，而薛世世無患矣。
units.en: Qi will gain the eastern territories and become stronger, while Xue will have no troubles for generations.
units.literal: Qi obtain east country more strong, Xue generation generation no worry.

units.zh: 秦不大弱，而處三晉之西，三晉必重齊。」
units.en: Qin will not be greatly weakened, and as it remains west of the Three Jin, the Three Jin will certainly value Qi.'
units.literal: Qin not great weak, dwell three Jin west, three Jin certainly heavy Qi."

units.zh: 薛公曰：「善。」
units.en: Lord Xue said: 'Good.'
units.literal: Xue Gong say: Good.

units.zh: 因令韓、魏賀秦，使三國無攻，而不借兵食於西周矣。
units.en: He then had Han and Wei congratulate Qin, causing the three states to cease attacking, and he no longer borrowed troops and provisions from Western Zhou.
units.literal: He then made Han and Wei congratulate Qin, causing the three states not to attack, and no longer borrowed soldiers and provisions from Western Zhou.

units.zh: 是時，楚懷王入秦，秦留之，故欲必出之。
units.en: At this time, King Huai of Chu had entered Qin and been detained there, so Qi wanted to secure his release.
units.literal: This time, Chu Huai King enter Qin, Qin detain him, therefore wish certainly emerge him.

units.zh: 秦不果出楚懷王。
units.en: Qin did not in fact release King Huai of Chu.
units.literal: Qin not indeed emerge Chu Huai King.

units.zh: 孟嘗君相齊，其舍人魏子為孟嘗君收邑入，三反而不致一入。
units.en: Lord Mengchang was chancellor of Qi. His retainer Wei Zi collected city revenues for Lord Mengchang, and three times he returned without bringing a single revenue.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun chancellor Qi, his house person Wei Zi for Meng Chang Jun collect city income, three return not bring one income.

units.zh: 孟嘗君問之，對曰：「有賢者，竊假與之，以故不致入。」
units.en: Lord Mengchang questioned him, and he replied: 'There is a worthy person, so I secretly lent it to him, and for this reason did not bring the revenue.'
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun ask him, answer: Have worthy person, secretly lend with him, with reason not bring income.

units.zh: 孟嘗君怒而退魏子。
units.en: Lord Mengchang grew angry and dismissed Wei Zi.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun angry and dismiss Wei Zi.

units.zh: 居數年，人或毀孟嘗君於齊湣王曰：「孟嘗君將為亂。」
units.en: After several years, someone slandered Lord Mengchang to King Min of Qi, saying: 'Lord Mengchang is going to rebel.'
units.literal: Dwell several years, person or slander Meng Chang Jun at Qi Min Wang: Meng Chang Jun will chaos.

units.zh: 及田甲劫湣王，湣王意疑孟嘗君，孟嘗君乃奔。
units.en: When Tian Jia abducted King Min, the king suspected Lord Mengchang, and Lord Mengchang fled.
units.literal: Reach Tian Jia kidnap Min King, Min King intention suspect Meng Chang Jun, Meng Chang Jun then flee.

units.zh: 魏子所與粟賢者聞之，乃上書言孟嘗君不作亂，請以身為盟，遂自剄宮門以明孟嘗君。
units.en: The worthy man to whom Wei Zi had given grain heard of this and submitted a petition stating that Lord Mengchang had not rebelled. He offered his own body as surety, then cut his own throat at the palace gate to prove Lord Mengchang's innocence.
units.literal: Wei Zi given grain worthy person hear, then present book speak Meng Chang Jun not make chaos, please with body as pledge, then self stab palace gate to bright Meng Chang Jun.

units.zh: 湣王乃驚，而蹤跡驗問，孟嘗君果無反謀，乃復召孟嘗君。
units.en: King Min was then shocked, and he traced and verified the matter. Lord Mengchang indeed had no rebellious plans, so he summoned Lord Mengchang again.
units.literal: Min King then shocked, track verify ask, Meng Chang Jun indeed no rebel plan, then again summon Meng Chang Jun.

units.zh: 孟嘗君因謝病，歸老於薛。
units.en: Lord Mengchang thereupon pleaded illness and returned to retire in Xue.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun because plead illness, return to old age at Xue.

units.zh: 湣王許之。
units.en: King Min permitted it.
units.literal: Min King permit.

units.zh: 其後，秦亡將呂禮相齊，欲困蘇代。
units.en: Afterward, Lu Li, a general who had fled Qin, became chancellor of Qi and wanted to put pressure on Su Dai.
units.literal: After, Qin perished general Lu Li chancellor Qi, wish distress Su Dai.

units.zh: 代乃謂孟嘗君曰：「周最於齊，至厚也，而齊王逐之，而聽親弗相呂禮者，欲取秦也。
units.en: Su Dai then said to Lord Mengchang: 'Zhou Zui has been deeply attached to Qi, yet the King of Qi expelled him and listened to Qin Fu while making Lu Li chancellor, because he wished to win over Qin.
units.literal: Dai then tell Meng Chang Jun: Zhou most at Qi, to thick, yet Qi Wang pursue him, listen close Fu not chancellor Lu Li, wish take Qin.

units.zh: 齊、秦合，則親弗與呂禮重矣。
units.en: If Qi and Qin unite, then Qin Fu and Lu Li will become important.
units.literal: Qi Qin unite, then close Fu with Lu Li heavy.

units.zh: 有用，齊、秦必輕君。
units.en: Once they are employed, Qi and Qin will certainly slight you.
units.literal: Have use, Qi Qin certainly light ruler.

units.zh: 君不如急北兵，趨趙以和秦、魏，收周最以厚行，且反齊王之信，又禁天下之變。
units.en: My lord would do better to move troops north quickly, hurry to Zhao to make peace with Qin and Wei, restore Zhou Zui in order to show generous conduct, recover the King of Qi's trust, and forestall changes throughout the world.
units.literal: Jun not as urgent north soldiers, hasten Zhao peace Qin Wei, collect Zhou most thick conduct, moreover return Qi King trust, again prohibit world change.

units.zh: 齊無秦，則天下集齊，親弗必走，則齊王孰與為其國也！」
units.en: If Qi loses Qin, the whole world will gather against Qi; Qin Fu will surely flee, and then with whom will the King of Qi govern his state?'
units.literal: Qi no Qin, then world gather Qi, close Fu certainly flee, then Qi Wang who with make his country!"

units.zh: 於是孟嘗君從其計，而呂禮嫉害於孟嘗君。
units.en: Lord Mengchang then followed his plan, but Lü Li grew jealous and acted against him.
units.literal: Lord Mengchang then followed his plan, but Lü Li grew jealous and harmed Lord Mengchang.

units.zh: 孟嘗君懼，乃遺秦相穰侯魏冉書曰：「吾聞秦欲以呂禮收齊，齊，天下之彊國也，子必輕矣。
units.en: Lord Mengchang was afraid, so he sent a letter to Qin chancellor Marquis Rang, Wei Ran: 'I hear that Qin wishes to use Lu Li to draw in Qi. Qi is one of the world's powerful states; you will certainly be slighted.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun fear, then send Qin chancellor Rang Hou Wei Ran book: I hear Qin wish with Lu Li collect Qi, Qi world strong country, you certainly light.

units.zh: 齊秦相取以臨三晉，呂禮必并相矣，是子通齊以重呂禮也。
units.en: If Qi and Qin join forces against the Three Jin, Lu Li will surely hold chancellorships in both states. In that case, you will have connected Qin with Qi only to make Lu Li important.
units.literal: Qi Qin mutually take face three Jin, Lu Li certainly together chancellor, is you through Qi heavy Lu Li.

units.zh: 若齊免於天下之兵，其讎子必深矣。
units.en: If Qi escapes attack by the armies of the world, its hatred of you will surely deepen.
units.literal: If Qi avoid world soldiers, its enemy you certainly deep.

units.zh: 子不如勸秦王伐齊。
units.en: You would do better to urge the King of Qin to attack Qi.
units.literal: You not as advise Qin King attack Qi.

units.zh: 齊破，吾請以所得封子。
units.en: When Qi is broken, I will request to enfeoff you with what is obtained.
units.literal: Qi break, I please with obtained enfeoff you.

units.zh: 齊破，秦畏晉之彊，秦必重子以取晉。
units.en: When Qi is broken, Qin will fear Jin's strength and will certainly value you in order to win over Jin.
units.literal: Qi break, Qin fear Jin strong, Qin certainly heavy you take Jin.

units.zh: 晉國敝於齊而畏秦，晉必重子以取秦。
units.en: Jin will be exhausted by Qi and afraid of Qin, so Jin will certainly value you in order to win over Qin.
units.literal: Jin country tired at Qi fear Qin, Jin certainly heavy you take Qin.

units.zh: 是子破齊以為功，挾晉以為重；
units.en: In this way, you will break Qi and make it your achievement, while holding Jin as your source of weight;
units.literal: Is you break Qi make merit, hold Jin make heavy;

units.zh: 是子破齊定封，秦、晉交重子。
units.en: you will break Qi, secure your enfeoffment, and have both Qin and Jin value you.
units.literal: Is you break Qi fix enfeoff, Qin Jin mutually heavy you.

units.zh: 若齊不破，呂禮復用，子必大窮。」
units.en: If Qi is not broken and Lü Li is employed again, you will certainly be greatly impoverished.'
units.literal: If Qi not break, Lu Li again use, you certainly great poor."

units.zh: 於是穰侯言於秦昭王伐齊，而呂禮亡。
units.en: Marquis Rang then spoke to King Zhao of Qin about attacking Qi, and Lü Li fled.
units.literal: Marquis Rang then spoke to King Zhao of Qin to attack Qi, and Lü Li fled.

units.zh: 後齊湣王滅宋，益驕，欲去孟嘗君。
units.en: Afterward King Min of Qi extinguished Song and became even more arrogant, wishing to remove Lord Mengchang.
units.literal: After Qi Min King extinguish Song, more arrogant, wish depart Meng Chang Jun.

units.zh: 孟嘗君恐，乃如魏。
units.en: Lord Mengchang was afraid, so he went to Wei.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun fear, then go Wei.

units.zh: 魏昭王以為相，西合於秦、趙，與燕共伐破齊。
units.en: King Zhao of Wei made him chancellor, united in the west with Qin and Zhao, and together with Yan attacked and broke Qi.
units.literal: Wei Zhao King with as chancellor, west unite Qin Zhao, with Yan together attack break Qi.

units.zh: 齊湣王亡在莒，遂死焉。
units.en: King Min of Qi fled to Ju, and died there.
units.literal: Qi Min King perish at Ju, then die.

units.zh: 齊襄王立，而孟嘗君中立於諸侯，無所屬。
units.en: King Xiang of Qi ascended, and Lord Mengchang remained neutral among the feudal lords, attached to none of them.
units.literal: Qi Xiang King stand, Meng Chang Jun middle stand at feudal lords, no belong.

units.zh: 齊襄王新立，畏孟嘗君，與連和，復親薛公。
units.en: King Xiang of Qi had newly ascended and feared Lord Mengchang, so he made peace with him and again drew close to Lord Xue.
units.literal: Qi Xiang King new stand, fear Meng Chang Jun, with connect peace, again close Xue Gong.

units.zh: 文卒，謚為孟嘗君。
units.en: Tian Wen died and was posthumously named Lord Mengchang.
units.literal: Wen die, posthumous name Meng Chang Jun.

units.zh: 諸子爭立，而齊魏共滅薛。
units.en: The sons contended for succession, and Qi and Wei together extinguished Xue.
units.literal: The sons contended to establish themselves, and Qi and Wei together extinguished Xue.

units.zh: 孟嘗絕嗣無後也。
units.en: Lord Mengchang had no surviving line of descendants.
units.literal: Meng Chang cut posterity no after.

units.zh: 初，馮驩聞孟嘗君好客，躡蹻而見之。
units.en: At first, Feng Huan heard that Lord Mengchang loved guests, and came to see him wearing straw sandals.
units.literal: Originally, Feng Huan hear Meng Chang Jun good guest, step shoe see him.

units.zh: 孟嘗君曰；
units.en: Lord Mengchang said:
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun say;

units.zh: 「先生遠辱，何以教文也？」
units.en: 'Sir, you have honored me by coming from afar. What instruction do you have for me?'
units.literal: Mister far disgrace, what teach Wen?

units.zh: 馮驩曰：「聞君好士，以貧身歸於君。」
units.en: Feng Huan said: 'I have heard that my lord loves scholars, so in my poverty I have come to place myself under you.'
units.literal: Feng Huan say: Hear jun good scholar, with poor body belong jun.

units.zh: 孟嘗君置傳舍十日，孟嘗君問傳舍長曰：「客何所為？」
units.en: Lord Mengchang lodged him in the guest house for ten days, then asked the guest house manager: 'What is the guest doing?'
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun place guest house ten days, Meng Chang Jun ask guest house long: Guest what do?

units.zh: 答曰：「馮先生甚貧，猶有一劍耳，又蒯緱。
units.en: He replied: 'Master Feng is very poor. He has only one sword, and its hilt is wrapped in rushes.
units.literal: Answer: Feng mister very poor, still have one sword, moreover rush-wrapped hilt.

units.zh: 彈其劍而歌曰『長鋏歸來乎，食無魚』。」
units.en: He strums his sword and sings: "Long sword, let us go home! There is no fish to eat.".'
units.literal: Strum his sword sing: Long sword return, eat no fish."

units.zh: 孟嘗君遷之幸舍，食有魚矣。
units.en: Lord Mengchang moved him to the favored quarters, and he had fish to eat.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun move to favored house, eat have fish.

units.zh: 五日，又問傳舍長。
units.en: After five days, he again asked the guest house manager.
units.literal: Five days, again ask guest house long.

units.zh: 答曰：「客復彈劍而歌曰『長鋏歸來乎，出無輿』。」
units.en: He replied: 'The guest again strums his sword and sings: "Long sword, let us go home! There is no carriage to ride in."'
units.literal: Answer: Guest again strum sword sing: Long sword return, emerge no carriage.

units.zh: 孟嘗君遷之代舍，出入乘輿車矣。
units.en: Lord Mengchang moved him to the upper quarters, and he rode in a carriage when going in and out.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun move to upper house, enter emerge ride carriage.

units.zh: 五日，孟嘗君復問傳舍長。
units.en: After five days, Lord Mengchang again asked the guest house manager.
units.literal: Five days, Meng Chang Jun again ask guest house long.

units.zh: 舍長答曰：「先生又嘗彈劍而歌曰『長鋏歸來乎，無以為家』。」
units.en: The house manager replied: 'The gentleman has again strummed his sword and sung: "Long sword, let us go home! There is no way to support a household."'
units.literal: House long answer: Mister again once strum sword sing: Long sword return, no make family.

units.zh: 孟嘗君不悅。
units.en: Lord Mengchang was displeased.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun not pleased.

units.zh: 居朞年，馮驩無所言。
units.en: After dwelling there a year, Feng Huan said nothing.
units.literal: Dwell season year, Feng Huan no speak.

units.zh: 孟嘗君時相齊，封萬戶於薛。
units.en: Lord Mengchang was then chancellor of Qi, and was enfeoffed with ten thousand households at Xue.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun then chancellor Qi, enfeoff ten thousand households at Xue.

units.zh: 其食客三千人。
units.en: He had three thousand retainers.
units.literal: His eat guests three thousand people.

units.zh: 邑入不足以奉客，使人出錢於薛。
units.en: The city revenues were insufficient to serve the guests, so he had people lend money at Xue.
units.literal: City income not sufficient serve guests, make person lend money at Xue.

units.zh: 歲餘不入，貸錢者多不能與其息，客奉將不給。
units.en: After more than a year there was no income, and many of the borrowers could not pay their interest, so the guests' provisions were about to run out.
units.literal: Year more not income, lend money people many cannot give their interest, guest serve will not give.

units.zh: 孟嘗君憂之，問左右：「何人可使收債於薛者？」
units.en: Lord Mengchang worried about this and asked his attendants: 'Who can be sent to collect the debts at Xue?'
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun worry, ask left right: What person can make collect debt at Xue?

units.zh: 傳舍長曰：「代舍客馮公形容狀貌甚辯，長者，無他伎能，宜可令收債。」
units.en: The guest house manager said: 'Master Feng, the guest in the upper quarters, is highly articulate and a man of mature years. He has no other special skills, but he should be suitable for collecting debts.'
units.literal: Guest house long say: Upper house guest Feng Gong appearance manner very eloquent, elder, no other skill ability, suitable can make collect debt.

units.zh: 孟嘗君乃進馮驩而請之曰：「賓客不知文不肖，幸臨文者三千餘人，邑入不足以奉賓客，故出息錢於薛。
units.en: Lord Mengchang then summoned Feng Huan and requested of him: 'The guests do not know that I am unworthy, and fortunately more than three thousand have come to me. The city revenues are insufficient to serve the guests, so I lent money at interest in Xue.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun then advance Feng Huan request him: Guests not know Wen not worthy, fortunate arrive Wen three thousand more people, city income not sufficient serve guests, therefore lend interest money at Xue.

units.zh: 薛歲不入，民頗不與其息。
units.en: Xue brings no income, and the people do not pay interest.
units.literal: Xue year not income, people rather not give their interest.

units.zh: 今客食恐不給，願先生責之。」
units.en: Now the guests' food may not be sufficient. I wish you, sir, to collect it.'
units.literal: Now guest eat fear not give, wish mister collect it."

units.zh: 馮驩曰；
units.en: Feng Huan said:
units.literal: Feng Huan say;

units.en: 'Very well.'
units.literal: Yes.

units.zh: 辭行，至薛，召取孟嘗君錢者皆會，得息錢十萬。
units.en: He took his leave and went to Xue. He summoned everyone who had borrowed Lord Mengchang's money, and when they had all assembled, he collected one hundred thousand in interest money.
units.literal: Leave go, arrive Xue, summon take Meng Chang Jun money all meet, obtain interest money one hundred thousand.

units.zh: 乃多釀酒，買肥牛，召諸取錢者，能與息者皆來，不能與息者亦來，皆持取錢之券書合之。
units.en: Then he brewed much wine, bought fat cattle, summoned all who had taken the money—those who could pay interest all came, those who could not pay interest also came—and they all held their money-taking contracts to verify them.
units.literal: Then much brew wine, buy fat cow, summon various take money, can give interest all come, cannot give interest also come, all hold take money contract book verify.

units.zh: 齊為會，日殺牛置酒。
units.en: Together they held a gathering, slaughtering cattle and setting out wine each day.
units.literal: Together make meeting, day kill cow set wine.

units.zh: 酒酣，乃持券如前合之，能與息者，與為期；
units.en: When the wine was flowing freely, he took the contracts and checked them as before. For those who could pay interest, he set deadlines;
units.literal: Wine intense, then hold contract as before verify, can give interest, give period;

units.zh: 貧不能與息者，取其券而燒之。
units.en: for the poor who could not pay interest, he took their contracts and burned them.
units.literal: Poor cannot give interest, take their contract burn.

units.zh: 曰：「孟嘗君所以貸錢者，為民之無者以為本業也；
units.en: He said: 'Lord Mengchang's reason for lending money was to provide capital for those people who had none to establish their livelihood;
units.literal: Say: Meng Chang Jun so lend money, for people none make base industry;

units.zh: 所以求息者，為無以奉客也。
units.en: his reason for seeking interest was that he had nothing to serve guests with.
units.literal: So seek interest, for no serve guests.

units.zh: 今富給者以要期，貧窮者燔券書以捐之。
units.en: Now for those who are rich and well-off, we set periods; for the poor, we burn the contracts to relieve them.
units.literal: Now rich sufficient give period, poor burn contract book donate.

units.zh: 諸君彊飲食。
units.en: All of you, eat and drink your fill.
units.literal: Gentlemen strongly eat drink.

units.zh: 有君如此，豈可負哉！」
units.en: With a lord like this, how could you betray him!'
units.literal: Have jun like this, how can betray!

units.zh: 坐者皆起，再拜。
units.en: All those seated rose and bowed twice.
units.literal: Sit all rise, twice bow.

units.zh: 孟嘗君聞馮驩燒券書，怒而使使召驩。
units.en: Lord Mengchang heard that Feng Huan had burned the contracts, grew angry, and sent a messenger to summon Huan.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun hear Feng Huan burn contract book, angry make messenger summon Huan.

units.zh: 驩至，孟嘗君曰：「文食客三千人，故貸錢於薛。
units.en: When Huan arrived, Lord Mengchang said: 'I have three thousand retainers, so I lent money at Xue.
units.literal: Huan arrive, Meng Chang Jun say: Wen eat guests three thousand people, therefore lend money at Xue.

units.zh: 文奉邑少，而民尚多不以時與其息，客食恐不足，故請先生收責之。
units.en: My enfeoffed city gives little revenue, and many people still do not pay their interest on time. I fear the guests' food will be insufficient, so I asked you, sir, to collect and demand it.
units.literal: Wen serve city few, people still many not with time give their interest, guest eat fear not sufficient, therefore please mister collect demand.

units.zh: 聞先生得錢，即以多具牛酒而燒券書，何？」
units.en: I heard that as soon as you, sir, obtained the money, you prepared much beef and wine and burned the contracts. Why?'
units.literal: Hear mister obtain money, then with many prepare cow wine burn contract book, why?"

units.zh: 馮驩曰：「然。
units.en: Feng Huan said: 'Yes.
units.literal: Feng Huan say: Correct.

units.zh: 不多具牛酒即不能畢會，無以知其有餘不足。
units.en: If I did not prepare much beef and wine, I could not complete the gathering and would have no way to know who had surplus and who was insufficient.
units.literal: Not many prepare cow wine then cannot finish meeting, no know their have remain not sufficient.

units.zh: 有餘者，為要期。
units.en: For those with surplus, I set periods.
units.literal: Have remain, for set period.

units.zh: 不足者，雖守而責之十年，息愈多，急，即以逃亡自捐之。
units.en: For those who lacked enough, even if I kept watch over them and demanded payment for ten years, the interest would only grow. If pressed too hard, they would flee and abandon themselves.
units.literal: Not sufficient, though guard demand ten year, interest more, urgent then escape perish self donate.

units.zh: 若急，終無以償，上則為君好利不愛士民，下則有離上抵負之名，非所以厲士民彰君聲也。
units.en: If they were pressed, they would ultimately have no way to repay. Above, you would gain a reputation for loving profit and not loving scholars and commoners; below, they would gain a reputation for estrangement from their superior and resistance to debts. That is not the way to encourage scholars and commoners or make your reputation shine.
units.literal: If urgent, finally no repay, up then ruler good profit not love scholar people, down then have leave up resist negative name, not so encourage scholar people bright ruler sound.

units.zh: 焚無用虛債之券，捐不可得之虛計，令薛民親君而彰君之善聲也，君有何疑焉！」
units.en: By burning the contracts for useless, empty debts and discarding calculations that could never be realized, I made the people of Xue draw close to you and made your good reputation shine. What doubt can you have about this?'
units.literal: Burn no use empty debt contract, donate cannot obtain empty plan, make Xue people close jun bright jun good sound, jun have what doubt!"

units.zh: 孟嘗君乃拊手而謝之。
units.en: Lord Mengchang then clapped his hands and thanked him.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun then clap hand thank him.

units.zh: 齊王惑於秦、楚之毀，以為孟嘗君名高其主而擅齊國之權，遂廢孟嘗君。
units.en: The King of Qi was confused by the slander from Qin and Chu, thinking that Lord Mengchang's reputation surpassed his lord and he monopolized Qi's power, so he deposed Lord Mengchang.
units.literal: Qi King confused at Qin Chu slander, consider Meng Chang Jun name high his lord monopolize Qi country power, then depose Meng Chang Jun.

units.zh: 諸客見孟嘗君廢，皆去。
units.en: When the guests saw that Lord Mengchang had been deposed, they all left.
units.literal: When the guests saw Lord Mengchang deposed, they all left.

units.zh: 馮驩曰：「借臣車一乘，可以入秦者，必令君重於國而奉邑益廣，可乎？」
units.en: Feng Huan said: 'Lend your subject one carriage in which I can enter Qin, and I will surely make you important in the state and broaden your enfeoffed city. May I do this?'
units.literal: Feng Huan say: Borrow minister carriage one ride, can enter Qin, certainly make jun heavy at country serve city more broad, can?

units.zh: 孟嘗君乃約車幣而遣之。
units.en: Lord Mengchang then prepared carriages and gifts and sent him away.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun then bind carriage currency send him.

units.zh: 馮驩乃西說秦王曰：「天下之游士馮軾結靷西入秦者，無不欲彊秦而弱齊；
units.en: Feng Huan then went west and persuaded the King of Qin, saying: 'Among the wandering persuaders of the world, all who lean on their carriage rails and tie their reins to go west into Qin wish to strengthen Qin and weaken Qi;
units.literal: Feng Huan then west advise Qin Wang: World travel scholars Feng Ju tie rein west enter Qin, no not wish strong Qin weak Qi;

units.zh: 馮軾結靷東入齊者，無不欲彊齊而弱秦。
units.en: all who lean on their carriage rails and tie their reins to go east into Qi wish to strengthen Qi and weaken Qin.
units.literal: Feng Ju tie rein east enter Qi, no not wish strong Qi weak Qin.

units.zh: 此雄雌之國也，勢不兩立為雄，雄者得天下矣。」
units.en: These are rival states, male and female; power cannot allow both to stand as male. The male will win the world.'
units.literal: This male female country, power not two stand male, male obtain world."

units.zh: 秦王跽而問之曰：「何以使秦無為雌而可？」
units.en: The King of Qin knelt upright and asked him: 'How can Qin avoid becoming the female?'
units.literal: Qin Wang kneel ask: What make Qin no be female can?

units.zh: 馮驩曰：「王亦知齊之廢孟嘗君乎？」
units.en: Feng Huan said: 'Does Your Majesty know that Qi has dismissed Lord Mengchang?'
units.literal: Feng Huan say: Wang also know Qi waste Meng Chang Jun?

units.zh: 秦王曰：「聞之。」
units.en: The King of Qin said: 'I have heard of it.'
units.literal: Qin Wang say: Hear.

units.zh: 馮驩曰：「使齊重於天下者，孟嘗君也。
units.en: Feng Huan said: 'The man who gave Qi weight in the world was Lord Mengchang.
units.literal: Feng Huan say: Make Qi heavy at world, Meng Chang Jun.

units.zh: 今齊王以毀廢之，其心怨，必背齊；
units.en: Now the King of Qi has dismissed him because of slander. His heart is resentful, and he will certainly turn his back on Qi.
units.literal: Now Qi Wang with slander waste him, his heart resent, certainly back Qi;

units.zh: 背齊入秦，則齊國之情，人事之誠，盡委之秦，齊地可得也，豈直為雄也！
units.en: If he turns his back on Qi and enters Qin, then Qi's circumstances and the true state of its affairs will all be handed over to Qin. Qin could take Qi's lands. Why stop at merely becoming a hegemon?
units.literal: Back Qi enter Qin, then Qi country emotion, person affairs sincere, all entrust Qin, Qi land can obtain, how only be male!

units.zh: 君急使使載幣陰迎孟嘗君，不可失時也。
units.en: My lord should urgently send a messenger loaded with gifts to secretly welcome Lord Mengchang. You cannot lose this opportunity.
units.literal: Lord urgently make messenger load gifts secretly welcome Meng Chang Lord; must not lose the timing.

units.zh: 如有齊覺悟，復用孟嘗君，則雌雄之所在未可知也。」
units.en: If Qi awakens and employs Lord Mengchang again, then who will be male and who female cannot be known.'
units.literal: If had Qi wake, again use Meng Chang Lord, then male female where did not could know."

units.zh: 秦王大悅，乃遣車十乘黃金百鎰以迎孟嘗君。
units.en: The King of Qin was greatly pleased, and sent ten carriages and a hundred yi of gold to welcome Lord Mengchang.
units.literal: Qin King great pleased, then send carriage ten ride gold hundred yi welcome Meng Chang Lord.

units.zh: 馮驩辭以先行，至齊，說齊王曰：「天下之游士馮軾結靷東入齊者，無不欲彊齊而弱秦者；
units.en: Feng Huan took leave and went ahead to Qi. When he arrived, he persuaded the King of Qi, saying: 'Among the wandering persuaders of the world, all who lean on their carriage rails and tie their reins to go east into Qi wish to strengthen Qi and weaken Qin;
units.literal: Feng Huan leave with first go, arrive Qi, advise Qi Wang: World travel scholars Feng Ju tie rein east enter Qi, no not wish strong Qi weak Qin;

units.zh: 馮軾結靷西入秦者，無不欲彊秦而弱齊者。
units.en: all who lean on their carriage rails and tie their reins to go west into Qin wish to strengthen Qin and weaken Qi.
units.literal: Feng Ju tie rein west enter Qin, no did not wish strong Qin weak Qi.

units.zh: 夫秦齊雄雌之國，秦彊則齊弱矣，此勢不兩雄。
units.en: Qin and Qi are rival states. If Qin is strong, then Qi is weak; the balance of power cannot allow two dominant powers.
units.literal: Qin Qi male female country, Qin strong then Qi weak, this power did not two male.

units.zh: 今臣竊聞秦遣使車十乘載黃金百鎰以迎孟嘗君。
units.en: Now I have heard in private that Qin has sent messengers with ten carriages and a hundred measures of gold to welcome Lord Mengchang.
units.literal: Now I have heard in private that Qin has sent messengers with ten carriages carrying a hundred measures of gold to welcome Lord Mengchang.

units.zh: 孟嘗君不西則已，西入相秦則天下歸之，秦為雄而齊為雌，雌則臨淄、即墨危矣。
units.en: If Lord Mengchang does not go west, that is one thing; but if he goes west to become Qin's chancellor, the whole world will turn to him. Qin will become dominant and Qi subordinate. If Qi is subordinate, then Linzi and Jimo will be in grave danger.
units.literal: If Lord Mengchang does not go west then it is fine, but if he goes west to serve as Chancellor of Qin then the world will return to him; Qin will be the 'male' and Qi will be the 'female', and if Qi is the 'female' then Linzi and Jimo will be in danger.

units.zh: 王何不先秦使之未到，復孟嘗君，而益與之邑以謝之？
units.en: Why does Your Majesty not restore Lord Mengchang before Qin's envoys arrive, increase his fief, and apologize to him?
units.literal: Wang what not before Qin messenger not arrive, restore Meng Chang Jun, moreover give him city thank?

units.zh: 孟嘗君必喜而受之。
units.en: Lord Mengchang will certainly be pleased and accept it.
units.literal: Lord Mengchang will certainly be happy and receive it.

units.zh: 秦雖彊國，豈可以請人相而迎之哉！
units.en: Though Qin is a powerful state, how can it invite another state's man to become its chancellor and welcome him away?
units.literal: Qin though strong country, how can with please person chancellor welcome him!

units.zh: 折秦之謀，而絕其霸彊之略。」
units.en: This will break Qin's plan and cut off its strategy for hegemony and strength.'
units.literal: Break Qin's plot, and cut off its hegemon strong strategy."

units.zh: 齊王曰：「善。」
units.en: The King of Qi said: 'Good.'
units.literal: Qi Wang say: Good.

units.zh: 乃使人至境候秦使。
units.en: So he sent someone to the border to wait for the messengers from Qin.
units.literal: Then he sent someone to the border to wait for the messengers from Qin.

units.zh: 秦使車適入齊境，使還馳告之，王召孟嘗君而復其相位，而與其故邑之地，又益以千戶。
units.en: Just as the Qin envoys' carriages crossed into Qi, a messenger raced back to report the news. The King immediately summoned Lord Mengchang, restored him to the chancellorship, returned his former lands, and even increased his fief by another thousand households.
units.literal: When the carriages of the Qin messengers had just entered the border of Qi, a messenger was sent back at full gallop to report it. The King summoned Lord Mengchang, restored him to his position as Chancellor, gave him back his former fief, and added a thousand more households to it.

units.zh: 秦之使者聞孟嘗君復相齊，還車而去矣。
units.en: Upon hearing that Lord Mengchang had been restored to power in Qi, the Qin envoys turned their carriages around and departed.
units.literal: When the messengers of Qin heard that Lord Mengchang had been restored as Chancellor of Qi, they turned their carriages and left.

units.zh: 自齊王毀廢孟嘗君，諸客皆去。
units.en: Ever since the King of Qi had disgraced and dismissed Lord Mengchang, his many retainers had all abandoned him.
units.literal: Since the King of Qi had slandered and deposed Lord Mengchang, all the guests had left.

units.zh: 後召而復之，馮驩迎之。
units.en: When he was finally recalled and restored to office, only Feng Huan was there to welcome him back.
units.literal: After he was summoned and restored, Feng Huan welcomed him.

units.zh: 未到，孟嘗君太息嘆曰：「文常好客，遇客無所敢失，食客三千有餘人，先生所知也。
units.en: Before Feng Huan arrived, Lord Mengchang sighed deeply and said: 'I have always loved guests and never dared fail in how I treated them. You know that I had more than three thousand retainers.
units.literal: Not arrive, Meng Chang Jun sigh: Wen often good guest, meet guest no dare lose, eat guests three thousand more people, mister know.

units.zh: 客見文一日廢，皆背文而去，莫顧文者。
units.en: When the retainers saw me dismissed that day, they all turned their backs and left, not one of them sparing me a second thought.
units.literal: The guests saw Wen [Lord Mengchang] deposed one day, they all turned their backs on Wen and left, none regarded Wen.

units.zh: 今賴先生得復其位，客亦有何面目復見文乎？
units.en: Now, thanks to you, sir, I have recovered my position. What face do those guests have to see me again?
units.literal: Now rely mister obtain restore position, guests also have what face again see Wen?

units.zh: 如復見文者，必唾其面而大辱之。」
units.en: If I see them again, I will spit in their faces and humiliate them greatly.'
units.literal: If I see them again, I will certainly spit in their faces and greatly disgrace them."

units.zh: 馮驩結轡下拜。
units.en: Feng Huan dropped his reins and bowed low.
units.literal: Feng Huan tied the reins and descended to bow.

units.zh: 孟嘗君下車接之，曰：「先生為客謝乎？」
units.en: Lord Mengchang got down from his carriage to receive him and said: 'Sir, are you apologizing on behalf of the guests?'
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun descend carriage meet him, say: Mister for guests thank?

units.zh: 馮驩曰：「非為客謝也，為君之言失。
units.en: Feng Huan said: 'I am not apologizing for the guests; I am saying that my lord's words are mistaken.
units.literal: Feng Huan say: Not for guests thank, for jun words lose.

units.zh: 夫物有必至，事有固然，君知之乎？」
units.en: There are things that must come, and affairs that are naturally so. Does my lord know this?'
units.literal: Things have must arrive, affairs have certainly so, jun know?"

units.zh: 孟嘗君曰：「愚不知所謂也。」
units.en: Lord Mengchang said: 'In my ignorance, I do not understand what you mean.'
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun say: Foolish not know so called.

units.zh: 曰：「生者必有死，物之必至也；
units.en: Feng Huan said: 'The living must die; this is one of the things that must come.
units.literal: Say: Live must have die, things must arrive;

units.zh: 富貴多士，貧賤寡友，事之固然也。
units.en: Wealth and status attract many, while poverty and low station find few friends. This is simply the way of the world.
units.literal: Wealth and nobility bring many scholars; poverty and lowliness bring few friends. This is the natural order of things.

units.zh: 君獨不見夫（朝）趣市［朝］者乎？
units.en: Has my lord never seen people hurrying to the morning market?
units.literal: Jun alone not see rush market morning?

units.zh: 明旦，側肩爭門而入；
units.en: At dawn, people jostle shoulder-to-shoulder, competing to enter the marketplace.
units.literal: At bright dawn, they crowd shoulders and compete to enter the gate;

units.zh: 日暮之後，過市朝者掉臂而不顧。
units.en: But after sunset, those passing by the market swing their arms and do not spare it a glance.
units.literal: After sunset, those who pass the marketplace swing their arms and do not look back.

units.zh: 非好朝而惡暮，所期物忘其中。
units.en: It is not that they love morning and hate evening; it is only that what they were seeking is no longer there.
units.literal: It is not that they love the morning and hate the evening; it is that what they looked for is no longer there.

units.zh: 今君失位，賓客皆去，不足以怨士而徒絕賓客之路。
units.en: Now that you have lost your position and your retainers have left, there is no reason to resent them or to needlessly close the door to future guests.
units.literal: Now you lost your position, the guests all left; it is not sufficient to resent the scholars and merely cut off the path for guests.

units.zh: 願君遇客如故。」
units.en: I hope you will continue to treat your guests just as you always have.'
units.literal: I wish you would treat your guests as you did before."

units.zh: 孟嘗君再拜曰：「敬從命矣。
units.en: Lord Mengchang bowed twice and said: 'I respectfully obey your command.
units.literal: Meng Chang Jun twice bow: Respect from command.

units.zh: 聞先生之言，敢不奉教焉。」
units.en: After hearing your words, how could I dare not follow your counsel?'
units.literal: Hearing your words, how could I dare not follow your teachings?"

units.zh: 太史公曰：吾嘗過薛，其俗閭里率多暴桀子弟，與鄒、魯殊。
units.en: The Grand Historian said: I once passed through Xue. The customs of its lanes and villages produced many violent and fierce young men, quite unlike Zou and Lu.
units.literal: Grand Historian say: I once pass Xue, its custom alley rate many fierce strong son younger brother, with Zou Lu different.

units.zh: 問其故，曰：「孟嘗君招致天下任俠，姦人入薛中蓋六萬餘家矣。」
units.en: When I asked the reason, people said: 'Lord Mengchang attracted bold retainers from all over the world, and some sixty thousand households of lawless men entered Xue.'
units.literal: Ask its reason, say: Meng Chang Jun recruit attract world bear knight, evil person enter Xue among cover sixty thousand more families.

units.zh: 世之傳孟嘗君好客自喜，名不虛矣。
units.en: The tradition that Lord Mengchang delighted in receiving guests was indeed no empty reputation.
units.literal: The world's tradition that Lord Mengchang loved guests and delighted in them is no empty reputation.
